The '''Great Stair''' was a staircase that was located at the center of the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], in [[Junction City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]]. The Great Stair was large and it linked the Grand Terminal's various [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]]. At some point between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a bagman for the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]] traveled to the Grand Terminal while transporting some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|funds]] that Taug was sending to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were tracking the movement of Taug's funds staked out the Great Stair and they followed the bagman to [[Docking Bay 112]].
